page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a distinct contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling in the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. However, the 32 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core, Passmark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core scores all positioning in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds for large uncached blocks, though the overall Passmark memory score remains in the lower 25% tier.

Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, the ecs.sn2.7xlarge is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage its 32 dedicated cores rather than relying on high single-thread performance. Appropriate use cases include static web serving, database operations, and Redis caching, where it achieves average throughput. It is also capable of handling moderate LLM inference tasks for medium-sized models. From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a balanced resource density for parallelized workloads, though the lack of bundled local storage and lower single-core efficiency should be factored into architectural decisions.
